vb_textbox.text: 4 characters, red vs brown, purple vs grey. First you need to try every character out if they get more than 5. Stick with that character. Once they get under 5 twice in a row try the other colour for at least 2 rounds. If this is below 5 then jump back. Scores 6-9 are worth sticking on the same colour. I remember the patterns so I know I am hitting red and purple together. I only found the colours helpful, the position of the character or shape of the hats didn't seem to have any pattern so only focus on the colour. My score was just over 1000 for context. Hope this helps and good luck
